back_cover_blurb: Don't just read about data structures. Build them, test them and time them. Every structure in this book is a working class you write yourself, checked against Python's built-ins on thousands of random inputs and measured with real benchmarks, so you see Big O happen on your own screen.

Build arrays, linked lists, hash tables, heaps, search trees, an AVL tree, a trie, union-find and graphs; implement eight sorts, Dijkstra, Kruskal and more. Then master the interview patterns: two pointers, sliding window, prefix sums, BFS and DFS, dynamic programming, greedy and backtracking.
Every listing was run on Python 3.12 to 3.15. Every chapter has real-world uses and exercises with tested solutions.
